placements.why: The content describes a deployment gate policy with defined scope, ownership, and motivating incident — an organizational governance surface for releases that no existing strata category covers. This is the first envelope in a new repo; the content calls for a category to hold release-governance themes.
placements.title: Release and deployment policies as a governed organizational surface
placements.theme: Release trains require explicit governance gates — signed manifests, scoped environments, named owners — before artifacts ship to any environment.

placements.title: From unsigned artifacts to cryptographically gated releases
placements.theme: Deployment safety requires signed release manifests before any Meridian artifact ships to staging or production, established after observed failures of unsigned artifacts reaching staging.
placements.why: All five segments support one thematic container: the signed-manifest deployment gate — its requirement (src-1, src-3), its motivating incident of two unsigned artifacts reaching staging (src-2), its scope across staging and production (src-4), and its ownership under Quinton Fairweather (src-5). The incident is position-grain evidence FOR this leaf, not a separate leaf. No existing leaf holds this theme; the repo's graph is empty.
